codeReview.summary: The implementation fully addresses the three requested TUI UX fixes: pane delete confirmation now resolves friendly pane names with pane_id fallback, task deletion from TUI now calls delete_task with force=false, and new-task flow now auto-detects the current git repo when no workspaces are configured. Code changes are aligned with the feature description and expectedBehavior.

issues.description: test_tui_delete_task_uses_force_false does not directly assert the delete_task force flag. It only asserts that a task with no repos/worktrees is deleted, which would succeed for both force=true and force=false, so regression protection for this specific behavior is weak.
